summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_023 contract: it validates authorized execution events, emits append-only operational logs, derives traceable metrics and alerts, and makes deterministic retry decisions without mutating other motors, contracts, artifacts or motor_state files. Observed results matched the declared output families, blocking validation behavior, lineage requirements and retry boundaries in test_spec.md.
